correctness.rationale: Exact B-spline formulas supply all positive spectral densities in sharp odd dimensions and explicit odd-dimensional obstructions. The even-dimensional gap is closed separately: projected radial measures cannot have positive-radius atoms or inner spectral holes, and the upward jump for the fourth power violates monotonicity of the double Abel transform of any positive projection measure. The included exact SymPy checker independently reconstructs spline pieces, differential identities, jump sizes, and sign witnesses; the analytic projection/Bochner argument covers arbitrary configurations and integer dimensions.

value.rationale: The sinc powers are canonical diffraction and cardinal-B-spline Fourier building blocks; deciding the maximal ambient Euclidean dimension for a radial covariance is a motivated exact invariant. The five-power initial classification exhibits a nontrivial two-step dimension staircase, a positive boundary sphere atom, two genuine unit-radius spectral gaps, and an upward jump yielding a sharp obstruction to an even-dimensional lift. These structural features go beyond routine positivity reparameterizations.
